Specification: This module, named 'typedefs', serves as a collection of type alias definitions for use in other TLA+ specifications. The type aliases are provided in comments using a custom annotation syntax (e.g., @typeAlias), and they define common types such as PROCESS, VALUE, STEP, ROUND, ACTION, TRACE, PROPMESSAGE, PREMESSAGE, and MESSAGE. These aliases map to basic types like Str, Int, and structured record types, as well as sequences. The module itself contains only a single operator definition, TypeAliases == TRUE, and does not specify any algorithm, system behavior, or temporal properties. It is intended purely as a type definition utility for other modules to EXTEND or reference.
